description: Case 39 with a second memory that echoes the mood (feeling unsettled in a new flat) but is not about being unable to explain yourself. The winner must rest on the reader's note about the new job, not on the echo; a runner-up may use it.

input.cue: Alice telling the Caterpillar she can't explain herself because she isn't herself is exactly how I described my first month at the new job. Does it connect to what I wrote then?

tool_evidence.excerpt: First month at the new job: I kept introducing myself and it never sounded like me. I could not explain what I did because I did not know yet.
Moving into the new flat felt unsettling for the first fortnight and then suddenly it did not.
The Caterpillar asks who she is; Alice says she hardly knows, because she has been changed several times, and cannot explain herself because she is not herself.

book_judgement.strength_reason: One passage was retrieved within the permitted chapters.

criteria: Connects the reader's note about the new job with Alice's answer
Keeps the connection tentative and does not diagnose the reader
forbidden_claims: States what the reader's experience means about them
